+# Actual D03 mapped-input development extraction: initial result
+
+This uses the materially different complete-chain/atomic-responsibility input
+compiler reviewed at14f74c3e. It is not a third response to the ended eight-location
+context-request trial. Actual saved task5 owns69 original items and includes all1965
+visible blocks plus complete original native roots. Its134727 context-token estimate
+and wire `ca828c05` were already saved; no new provider request was made.
+
+Before dispatch, the parent read all69 original owned wrappers/root texts (57079
+decoded characters), verified the original2048661-byte SEC primary raw SHA and
+block1201 raw span, and froze `reference-before-blind.json` in commitf7cb3179.
+Reference SHA05a2adc7 predates any answer. Three reference relations distinguish
+limited historical settlement, currently ongoing tax-year audits and unnamed
+other taxing-authority examinations. Full shared context is provided but is not
+claimed independently semantically read in this reference. This source was already
+used in development, not a holdout. No business-scope change is approved here.
+
+The independent context used only the actual request's two messages, not the
+repository, original files, reference, old answers or correction dialogue.
+It read all supplied text/native parts/tables and recovered one truncated dictionary
+inspection. First raw response `f5d5368d` is kept unchanged:4 findings/4 unresolved,
+1165 pinned-reference output tokens (actual Codex hosted usage is unknown).
+46 conservative tools,3 messages, UTC16:07:42.109879–16:18:54.798332.
+
+Parent structural post-processing checks original wire/response digests,4096
+reference-token limit, strict fields, exact available reference triples and at
+least one owned reference per finding. It passes. Direct comparison supports
+the three pre-frozen source relations; the fourth finding's9M/2M settlement-related
+roll-forward decreases are in the pre-read table and are not misrepresented as
+fines, cash paid or identified cases. This fourth observation is a forward check,
+not an addition to the frozen expected answer. Event dates remain empty; annual
+periods, audited tax years and the year-end settlement cutoff remain separate.
+
+## Concrete input defect and scope limits
+
+The reader correctly identified missing native contexts c-88/c-89. Parent reproduced
+the defect from the actual restored XML:16 contextRef keys occur in supplied roots,
+and these two definitions are absent from the delivered dictionary. Both are in
+the authenticated original source's native unit8. Their dimensions describe taxes
+paid in Switzerland and other foreign jurisdictions, not examination locations.
+The cause is concrete: a complete XML root can include inline facts whose context
+definitions live beyond the originally selected fact-unit dictionaries. This is
+an input-closure defect, not grounds to blame the model, change the original source
+or infer missing dimensions. The initial answer/wire/reference remain unchanged.
+
+Accurate tax-examination statements do not alone establish an investigative or
+enforcement matter under D03. Existing v5 warns against expanding to every
+governmental administrative matter. The current broad draft task did not establish
+that relevance; no source assertion here becomes approved D03 current-involvement
+or case-count credit. Those meaning/coverage limits stay separate from fixing the
+two missing XML dictionaries.
+
+Verdict: limited source-relationship extraction and reference structure passed;
+the input needs dictionary closure repair. Initial context1 consumed; the one
+substantive-correction context remains unused. Next fix literal dependencies from
+the admitted source, test/review only that difference, then use at most that one
+correction. Do not resample the same input or reopen the old ended trial.
+
+There is no new native company acceptor for this wire. Parent's structural check
+is an evidence-level prototype, not the old D03 native mapper, independent code
+review, Result/Run or DeepSeek qualification. No old response is rebound to a new
+request. Program/source bytes, semantic correctness and company acceptance remain
+distinct. New business calls0/0/0; original ledger and production are untouched.
